solution: The lady was an acrobat in a circus troupe. Her job was to balance an apple on her head while another male performer threw knives at it. But because of her high heels, she was a few centimeters taller than usual. The male performer, who hadn't adjusted, missed and threw the knife into her head.
canonical_facts: The woman is a circus performer who balances an apple on her head for a knife-throwing act
High heels raise her head above its usual height
Her male partner does not adjust his throw and hits her head, killing her
